messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api-us-east queued_requests > 95th percentile for 3m. p95=1.2s -> 3.9s, p99=5.4s -> 18s, queue-depth=~24k. autoscaler reported 429s on pool create.
matt_oncall: I'm on it. seeing high inbound RTU from marketing/campaigns-east. Does X-Client-Id spike match the campaign?
anya_support: Yep, CS reporting ~18 accounts hitting timeouts since 19:03 UTC, several are high-throughput batch calls. Link to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4521
sarah_prod: quick check — GPU pool us-east-1a showing 100% allocated, provisioning attempts failing with quota/timeout. excerpt from provisioner: `ERROR provisioning: rate-limited: quota-exhausted or api timeout (504)`
kyle_infra: provisioning log snippet: ```time="2026-03-17T19:04:12Z" level=error msg="create-instance failed" err="QuotaExceededException: cannot allocate g4dn.xlarge"``` autoscaler keeps retrying and hitting cloud provider rate limits.
matt_oncall: OK. First mitigation: enable fallback routing to cheaper model variants for non-SLA tenants, and reduce per-tenant concurrency. Sarah, can you flip the fallback policy?
sarah_prod: Doing it now — toggling route: `PATCH /routing/policies/hosted/fallback` -> set "prefer_variant": "m-infer-quant" for tier=free,standard.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered by sarah_prod: routing-policy-update (sha: a1b2c3). Status: success.
matt_oncall: Seeing immediate drop in token compute for those clients ~ 30s after change. Queue growth slowed but still ~12k. p99 down to ~9s now.
kyle_infra: Provisioner heartbeat shows still failing to create nodes due to quota throttle. We can try manual borrow from dedicated pool (short-term) or force-evict low-priority jobs. Recommend evict non-customer low-priority background batches now.
ops-lead: Agreed, start evicting background-batches in us-east region. matt_oncall, coordinate with eng-sre to whitelist critical tenants from eviction.
eng-sre: Eviction runbook started. Command: `./infractl evict --region us-east --tag background-batch --grace 30s`
eng-sre: Eviction progress: 120 jobs evicted, reclaiming ~22 GPUs. Provisioner still hitting limits for new instances but reclaimed capacity is sufficient to run critical hosted pools. Queue dropping to ~4.5k.
anya_support: CS update to impacted customers sent: small delay, temporary fallback to compact model, monitoring ETA 30m. One customer asked for SLA credit — logging.
matt_oncall: Continuing to watch. Plan B if queue doesn't stabilize: enable 503-based shedding for noisy clients (X-Client-Id allowlist then rate-limit others). Not ideal but will protect platform. Thoughts?
sarah_prod: Prepare the 503 policy but don't flip yet. Also prepping a canary of prewarmed small instances in apac to siphon cross-region traffic if needed.
kyle_infra: FYI, cloud provider support engagement open — case #CP-99421. They flagged internal rate-plan limits will be lifted in ~50m. Until then we rely on reclaimed capacity + fallbacks.
matt_oncall: Noted. Current metrics: queue ~3.1k, p95=1.8s, p99=6.5s. We'll keep this thread for the incident timeline and handoff.
ops-lead: Night oncall @eng-sre will take at 21:00 UTC. matt_oncall please document what we toggled and current customer impact summary in Ops doc.
matt_oncall: Will do. Short summary: spike from marketing campaign -> provisioner rate limits -> attempted autoscale failed -> enabled model-variant fallback for non-SLA tenants + background-batch eviction -> reclaimed GPUs -> queue reduced from 24k -> 3k, p99 improved from 18s -> 6.5s. 12 customers reported timeouts, CS notified.
eng-sre: Adding logs and runbook steps to incident doc: /incidents/1758882222 (private).
matt_oncall: Handoff to night: please watch for reappearance of provisioner rate-limit errors or a secondary spike. If queue >10k again, escalate to infra-ops and consider temporary 503 shedding.
eng-sre: ack. I'll keep heartbeat checks running and escalation contacts ready.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity=high -> monitoring stable, recovery-in-progress. Next check-in in 20m.
matt_oncall: Closing slack thread for live ops, continuing postmortem collection. Night oncall assigned: eng-sre. :thumbsup:
ops-lead: Thanks team. Follow-up: schedule RCA and quota planning with cloud vendor first thing tomorrow.
